title: Allostatic-Load Biomarkers: 16 Markers in Five Physiological Systems

sheets.name: Table S13
rows: Allostatic-Load Biomarkers: 16 Markers in Five Physiological Systems
+20 mg/dL total cholesterol, ratio recomputed, if antilipidemic

Note. Markers are grouped by physiological system, with the number of markers in parentheses. Variables are the MIDUS Biomarker Project codes at MIDUS 2 (B4), MIDUS 3 (C4), and MIDUS Refresher 1 (RA4). Risk tail, the direction scored as dysregulated. Medication adjustments are applied before scoring for participants taking the listed medication. Each marker is standardized against its cohort's baseline mean and SD and oriented so that higher values indicate greater risk; the composite is the mean of these z scores, computed when at least 13 of the 16 are observed. BMI and waist-hip ratio are predictors, not components. HDL = high-density lipoprotein.
